description: Change a deck-list row (want_id from deck_status): its quantity and/or its section (main | sideboard). quantity 0 cuts the card. Cutting a card or lowering its count RELEASES the copies the deck held beyond the new count: staged ones are simply free again, sleeved ones physically return to "Unsorted". The response lists them under `released` — tell the user, they may need to take the card out of the deck box. Cutting a commander also removes it as commander. lang sets the language the row asks for (Scryfall's code; null follows the deck's): a preference, it changes no copy.

anyOf.description: Scryfall's language code: en, de, fr, it, es, pt, ja, ko, ru, zhs, zht, …
